acceptance: Owner publication approval, immutable package version/source commit and artifact SHA-256 equal to T6 are recorded; clean CI can fetch both primary and independent recovery source without privileged credentials.
Fresh isolated install and representative CLI/gate smoke from published bytes succeed; blocked-primary and wrong-recovery-hash cases respectively succeed with identical bytes and refuse.
Bootstrap record names independent reviewer, approved source head and full-delta evidence; source/lock/artifact association is verifiable.
Promotion evidence generation succeeds against the current candidate without granting Actions read permission; real PR-head attestation remains mandatory at cutover.
No source/build input changed after parity; if any changed, T6 is re-proven before this item can finish.
context:
T7. Normal merged-code authorization does not independently authorize package production publication. Stop for owner action if release rights/approval are absent.

Delivery: one Theseus PR (Theseus PR 1) carries governance bootstrap, package/installer, hosted workflows, local tooling, frozen source and parity proof. The release tag and first-promotion evidence come from that merged head, not from a separate PR.
description:
T7: after explicit owner authorization for release/publication, publish the exact wheel bytes T6 tested under theseus-reviewer, with immutable source association, dependency closure/hashes and a retained identical-hash independent recovery copy. Do not rebuild or introduce evaluator behaviour here. Complete the bootstrap record: BenchBox baseline commit, path map, normalized full-tree diff, named independent reviewer, approved head and resulting source/artifact hashes. First promotion uses this baseline as its old side because no previous Theseus lock exists.
Assemble full upstream-delta promotion evidence and the gate-readable record form chosen by the owner; its exact-head attachment occurs against the real cutover PR after creation, not an invented future head. Subsequent promotions compare prior locked source to candidate source.
Decision gate: package/asset production publication, publisher identity and credentials need owner approval; unavailable rights or naming conflict is a blocker. Guardrails: no latest refs, unverified fallback, secret-bearing candidate build, owner-attestation forgery, artefact rebuild, silent source change, fabricated provenance, or reusing a stale parity hash.
Distribution decision: GitHub Releases are sufficient initially. PyPI publication is optional, not a completion/cutover prerequisite. theseus-reviewer is the intended distribution name, not authorization or a requirement to publish on PyPI.
